- The test post-image, the live hooks under plugins/pipeline-core/hooks/, lib/, the tranche README, the other post-images and manifest sections, scratch/dispatch-wip/TR-G-F/ and TR-G-T3/.

5. Deviations from spec
- None to the briefed edits. One disclosed consequence of the F2 design (the "same control-character refusal" the briefing names): the pattern is applied to the whole git command including quoted text, so after the working cap a git commit -m with parentheses in the message, or a path containing parentheses, is now refused, where it was admitted before. This is only a narrowing (no admission widened) and the obligations route (git commit -F file -- paths) is unaffected. It is stated in the doc comment and the manifest.
- The record was created after one read-only git rev-parse HEAD (for candidateCommit), which is the first tool call after reading the briefing inputs and one refused Glob and one refused Write (GUARD-READ-TARGET, GUARD-BOOTSTRAP-RECEIPT-MISSING, cured with the preflight from the loaded plugin root).

6. Open items
- independent review: pending (delta Critic, Opus, per Ruling 138). PO acceptance: pending. Installing the post-image remains a signed-package step.
- Unverified by this evidence: the win32 branch of comparableScriptPath on native Windows (T49 (d) and (e) skip there; no platform seam exists, as TR-G-T3 reported); macOS. WSL only.
- F2 shapes beyond the three pinned ones (||, redirect, substitution, line break, git add && git commit) are refused by the same character class but have no case of their own.
- No stop condition triggered. Tool uses about 41 of a base cap of 45; the closing allowance was not needed. Not a closing-allowance handover: committed c7aa93102..., verified green as listed, nothing remains undone from the briefed DoD, no next-briefing adjustment other than the delta Critic.
